sources.title: 沈仁岩, 普陀山南海观音开光亲睹记, repost

sources.title: 舟山市志（1989—2005）下卷2, printed p.2334
sources.date: post-2005 compilation; edition date not independently established
sources.read_scope: Search-engine indexed passage read; full PDF/page not retrieved in this audit.
sources.assessment: Passage describes 5,000-plus attendees, light/clouds like white-robed Guanyin and about ten seconds. It expressly leaves causal explanation open.

sources.title: 普陀山气象佳景, 林之光, 气象知识 2014 no.6, printed pp.72–73 (relevant passage p.73)
sources.read_scope: Indexed first page (printed 72) and relevant passage of printed 73 read. Original PDF still times out or redirects to a missing page; no full PDF or visual page inspection. Bibliographic issue date 2014 no.6 controls over search-engine upload dates. Description and expert background do not alone establish that every eyewitness claim has an ordinary cause.
sources.assessment: Indexed printed page 73 describes the 30 October 1997 ceremony: overcast skies and intermittent rain, then sunlight through a cloud opening lighting the statue as the ceremony began, lasting about twenty minutes. It gives roughly 4,000 attendees and says one person recorded the scene. This is a published ordinary-lighting description. The recovered passage supplies no independent camera authentication, optical measurements or test of the stronger detached-figure reports.
sources.bibliographic_update: Indexed title 普陀山气象佳景, author 林之光, photos 张恩承; issue 2014/6, starts p.72. Full PDF still unrecovered.
sources.author_background: Lin Zhiguang (林之光), formerly a researcher and climate research division director at the Chinese Academy of Meteorological Sciences; 1959 Nanjing University meteorology graduate. Background verified in a 2014 China Science Daily interview and his 2017 first-person column (E06). Images credited to Zhang Encheng (张恩承).

limitations: No recovered same-week 1997 independently authored apparition newspaper article.
No named prior skeptical eyewitness positively attesting an identifiable Guanyin found.
No original calibrated optical or meteorological investigation found.
Selected video frames only; no complete scene-duration measurement.

expansion_20261102.notes: Original Phoenix transcript recovered; additional named testimony through later sources; 2003 newspaper citation lead; eleven new paused documentary screenshots; five institutional ceremony photographs. No tally changed. Source family links prevent double counting.
